title: Property Finder Scraper: UAE, KSA, Qatar, Bahrain, Egypt
metaDescription: Extract PropertyFinder listings across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Egypt and Qatar: prices, locations, agent contacts, amenities and specs.
intro: Paste PropertyFinder search links from the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Egypt or Qatar and get each listing's price, location, agent contact, amenities and specs.
useCases: Compare rents and prices across Dubai communities
Build agent and agency lists by area
Track new listings in a building or district

faq.q: Is there a Property Finder API?
faq.a: Only for agents managing their own listings. This actor reads any public Property Finder search link and returns each listing with price, location, size, rooms and amenities.
The UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain and Egypt: paste a search link from that country's Property Finder site.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Property Finder API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: Property Finder offers APIs to agents for managing their own listings, not public listing data. This actor reads public search results in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain and Egypt.
